o: A simplified representation of a thing from a specific perspective
A complete copy of every detail of a system
Only a diagram drawn in UML
5.1.vi: Model: biểu diễn đơn giản hoá từ một góc nhìn, giữ ý quan trọng, bỏ phần còn lại.
5.1.en: Model: a simplified representation from one perspective, keeping what matters.

5.1.q: Which is listed as a benefit of modeling?
5.1.vi: Mô hình giúp nắm requirement, nối requirement với design, ghi quyết định thiết kế, tổ chức hệ thống lớn.
5.1.en: Models capture requirements, link requirements and design, record decisions, organize large systems.

5.1.q: Which is NOT a modeling language listed in the lecture?
5.1.vi: Ví dụ modeling language: UML, C4 Model, BPMN, SysML.
5.1.en: Modeling languages: UML, C4 Model, BPMN, SysML.

5.1.q: Which is a behavioral (dynamic) UML diagram?
5.1.vi: Behavioral: use case, sequence, communication, state machine, activity. Structural: class, package, object, component, deployment.
5.1.en: Behavioral: use case, sequence, communication, state machine, activity. Structural: class, package, object, component, deployment.

5.1.vi: UML = Unified Modeling Language, được OMG chuẩn hoá năm 1997.
5.1.en: UML = Unified Modeling Language, adopted by OMG as a standard in 1997.

5.1.q: BPMN, another modeling language listed in the lecture, stands for:
5.1.vi: BPMN = Business Process Model and Notation. Các modeling language khác: UML, C4 Model, SysML.
5.1.en: BPMN = Business Process Model and Notation. Other modeling languages: UML, C4 Model, SysML.

5.2.q: The three main elements of a use case diagram are:
5.2.vi: Use case diagram: Actors · Use cases · Relationships.
5.2.en: Use case diagram: actors, use cases, relationships.

5.2.q: Many users who have the same role with the system are represented by:
5.2.vi: Nhiều người cùng vai → một actor; một người nhiều vai → nhiều actor.
5.2.en: Many users with one role → one actor; one user with many roles → many actors.

o: Observable results of value to the actor
5.2.vi: Use case: chuỗi hành động tạo kết quả quan sát được, có giá trị với actor; che giấu cấu trúc bên trong.
5.2.en: A use case: actions producing observable results of value to the actor; hides internals.

5.3.q: Which is NOT one of the path types of a use case flow of events?
5.3.vi: Luồng sự kiện: basic, alternative, exceptional paths.
5.3.en: Flows: basic, alternative and exceptional paths.

5.3.q: In a use case specification, the system state before the use case can begin is the:
5.3.vi: Precondition: trạng thái trước khi bắt đầu. Postcondition: trạng thái khi kết thúc.
5.3.en: Precondition: state before it begins. Postcondition: state when it is over.

5.3.q: In the PayVAT example, which actors are involved?
5.3.vi: PayVAT (UC1): actors Time, Government; precondition cuối quý kinh doanh.
5.3.en: PayVAT (UC1): actors Time and Government; precondition end of a business quarter.

5.3.q: A scenario relates to a use case like:
o: An object relates to a class
A class relates to a package
A test relates to a bug
An actor relates to a role
5.3.vi: Scenario là instance của use case, như object của class.
5.3.en: A scenario is an instance of a use case, like an object of a class.

5.4.q: Which relationship connects an actor and a use case?
5.4.vi: Association: actor ↔ use case. Include, Extend: giữa các use case. Generalization: tổng quát ↔ cụ thể.
5.4.en: Association: actor ↔ use case. Include, extend: between use cases. Generalization: general ↔ specific.

5.4.q: Which use case can stand alone?
o: Both must always be used together
5.4.vi: Included không đứng một mình; extending có thể đứng một mình.
5.4.en: The included one cannot stand alone; the extending one may.

5.4.q: In the Firefox example, "Load and Display web page" relates to "Show images" by:
5.4.vi: Load and Display «include» Show images; Read web page loud «extend» Load and Display.
5.4.en: Load and Display «include» Show images; Read web page loud «extend» Load and Display.

5.4.q: A well-defined use case should distribute variations into:
5.4.vi: Hành vi chung → include; biến thể → extend.

5.4.q: Which layout guideline is given for use case diagrams?
o: Minimize line crosses and group related elements
Use as many actors as possible
Put every use case in one row
5.4.vi: Bố cục: giảm đường cắt nhau, nhóm phần liên quan; chỉ đưa phần cần thiết.
5.4.en: Layout: minimize line crossings, group related elements; include only what is essential.

5.5.q: The interface used by other software systems, rather than people, is the:
5.5.vi: UI cho con người; API cho hệ thống khác.
5.5.en: UI for people; API for other systems.

5.5.q: According to the lecture, users often judge a system by:
o: Its interface rather than its functionality
5.5.vi: Người dùng thường đánh giá hệ thống qua giao diện hơn là chức năng.
5.5.en: Users often judge a system by its interface rather than its functionality.

5.5.q: Which human factor says inappropriate alarms and messages can increase stress?
5.5.vi: People make mistakes: cảnh báo, thông báo không phù hợp làm tăng căng thẳng.
5.5.en: People make mistakes: inappropriate alarms and messages increase stress.

5.5.vi: UI = User interface: tương tác, giao diện và cảm giác của màn hình. UX = User experience: toàn bộ trải nghiệm với sản phẩm.
5.5.en: UI = User interface: the interactivity, look and feel of a screen. UX = User experience: the user's overall experience with the product.

5.6.q: "The interface should provide appropriate interaction facilities for different types of system user" is:
5.6.vi: User diversity: cách tương tác phù hợp cho nhiều kiểu người dùng.
5.6.en: User diversity: suitable interaction for different types of users.

5.6.q: An undo button and confirmation before deleting mainly support which principle?
5.6.vi: Recoverability: cơ chế khôi phục khi lỗi (undo, xác nhận).
5.6.en: Recoverability: mechanisms to recover from errors (undo, confirmation).

5.6.q: "Semantic HTML that works with screen readers" belongs to which POUR principle?
5.6.vi: Perceivable: text thay ảnh, tương phản 4.5:1 · Operable: bàn phím · Understandable: nhãn rõ · Robust: HTML ngữ nghĩa, screen reader.
5.6.en: Perceivable: alt text, 4.5:1 · Operable: keyboard · Understandable: clear labels · Robust: semantic HTML, screen readers.

5.6.q: Clear labels, predictable navigation and helpful error messages belong to:
5.6.vi: Understandable: nhãn rõ, điều hướng dễ đoán, thông báo lỗi có ích.
5.6.en: Understandable: clear labels, predictable navigation, helpful errors.

5.7.q: Which interaction style lets the user read a list of items and select the most appropriate?
5.7.vi: Menu selection: đọc danh sách và chọn mục phù hợp.
5.7.en: Menu selection: read a list and select the best item.

5.7.q: Which interaction style responds to arbitrary sentences, with or without speech recognition?
5.7.vi: Natural language: phản hồi câu tuỳ ý, có hoặc không có nhận dạng giọng nói.
5.7.en: Natural language: responds to arbitrary sentences, with or without speech.

5.7.q: Analogue presentation (e.g. a bar chart) is best for showing:
5.7.vi: Analogue: giá trị tương đối. Digital: giá trị chính xác, ít chỗ.
5.7.en: Analogue: relative values. Digital: precise values, little space.

5.7.q: Information that changes during a session is:
5.7.vi: Static: khởi tạo đầu phiên. Dynamic: thay đổi trong phiên.
5.7.en: Static: set at session start. Dynamic: changes during the session.

5.8.q: Which user analysis technique models the steps involved in completing a task?
5.8.vi: Task analysis: mô hình các bước · Interview/questionnaire: hỏi · Ethnography: quan sát.
5.8.en: Task analysis: models steps · Interviews/questionnaires: ask · Ethnography: observe.

5.8.q: In system prototyping, the screen list is identified based on:
5.8.vi: Bước: screen list (dựa trên use case) → screen diagram → screen design → screen specification.
5.8.en: Steps: screen list (from use cases) → screen diagram → screen design → screen specification.

5.8.q: Which IS a usability attribute used in interface evaluation?
5.8.vi: Usability: learnability, speed of operation, robustness, recoverability, adaptability.
5.8.en: Usability: learnability, speed of operation, robustness, recoverability, adaptability.

5.8.q: Which is a simple interface evaluation technique listed in the lecture?
5.8.vi: Kỹ thuật đơn giản: phiếu hỏi, ghi màn hình/phiên, usage analytics (heatmap), công cụ thu lỗi.
5.8.en: Simple techniques: questionnaires, screen/session recording, analytics (heatmaps), error logging tools.

5.8.q: Which is a recommended color guideline?
o: Use color change to show a change in system status
Use color alone to communicate meaning
Use as many colors as possible
5.8.vi: Nên giới hạn số màu, đổi màu báo đổi trạng thái, mã màu nhất quán; lỗi thường gặp: dùng màu để truyền ý nghĩa.
5.8.en: Limit colors, use color change for status change, code consistently; mistake: color to convey meaning.

5.8.q: What should be the determining factor in error message design?
o: The background and experience of the users
The length of the stack trace
5.8.vi: Nền tảng và kinh nghiệm của người dùng quyết định cách viết thông báo; thông báo polite, concise, consistent, constructive.
5.8.en: Users' background and experience drive message design; polite, concise, consistent, constructive.

5.8.q: "Natural constraints" and "business constraints" are types of:
5.8.vi: Data validation: đừng tin người dùng; ràng buộc natural/business; early/late checking.
5.8.en: Data validation: don't trust users; natural/business constraints; early/late checking.
